release_notes.en-US: Version 2.2.0 stops broad interference with legitimate telephone and site JavaScript controls, adds signed reviewed global threat rules, and blocks a rotating malware campaign using narrow host and path indicators. Still no telemetry or remote code.

version.approval_notes: 2.2.0: Signed GitHub rule pack fetch (Ed25519, public JSON data only; no remote executable code). Adds exact-host, warning-domain, and domain-plus-path threat entries. Fixes false positives from tel:, sms:, and legitimate site JavaScript controls. Submitted ZIP is readable unminified source. Support: https://nokaangel.dev/support?project=grandmaguard
